title: Comparison of approaches for incorporating depredation on fisheries catches into Ecopath
authors: Lyndsay Clavareau; Martin P. Marzloff; Verena M. Trenkel; Catherine M. Bulman; Sophie Gourguet; Bertrand Le Gallic; Pierre-Yves Hernvann; Clara Péron; Nicolas Gasco; Johanna Faure; Paul Tixier
loadability_evidence: Native EwE model not verified. Article explicitly states underlying data cannot be shared publicly due to confidentiality agreements. 46-page review-manuscript PDF located; parameter completeness still requires extraction.
documentation_evidence: Case study specifies 59 groups: 38 area-specific and 21 shared between Crozet and Kerguelen; supplementary parameterization and fishery tables referenced.
notes: Combined spatial structure should not be mistaken for two independent complete EEZ models. Archimer labels 78763 main (15p), 78764 supplementary (46p). File 78764.pdf is a 46-page review manuscript of the same article, not a separate verified supplement.
quality_rationale: Provisional screening score. A readable source is not evidence of a successfully reconstructed or load-tested Ecopath model. Native EwE model not verified. Article explicitly states underlying data cannot be shared publicly due to confidentiality agreements. 46-page review-manuscript PDF located; parameter completeness still requires extraction.
geometry_method: No defensible digital study boundary located
geometry_note: Published study location identified, but no defensible numeric model-domain bounding box was extracted; exact author boundary remains unresolved.
recommendation: Crozet-specific groups and fishery are explicitly represented; combined model also includes Kerguelen. The island location coordinates in the text are not a model boundary.
coverage_note: Crozet-specific groups and fishery are explicitly represented; combined model also includes Kerguelen. The island location coordinates in the text are not a model boundary.
